title: Rav Chanan of Carthage

paragraphs: In Ketubot 27b: when Rav Dimi came, he said that Rav Chanan of Carthage related, “A case came before Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi,” etc. Bava Kamma 114b reads Rav Chana; see also the entry Chinena of Carthage.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Ketubot 27b passage has Rav Dimi reporting Rav Chanan Kartigena’s account before Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, with an alternative account before Rabbi. Bava Kamma 114b reads Rav Chana Kartigena and alternatively Rav Acha Kartigena. Hyman’s Chanan and Chana forms and his cross-reference are retained without merging the named figures or independently identifying the place.
